nights.title: Boney James
nights.name: Boney James
nights.extract: Boney James is an American saxophonist, recording artist, songwriter and record producer.

nights.title: Billy Strings
nights.name: Billy Strings
nights.extract: William Lee Apostol, known by the stage name Billy Strings, is an American guitarist, singer, songwriter, and bluegrass musician. Three of his albums, Home, Live Vol. 1, and Highway Prayers, won the Grammy Award for Best Bluegrass Album, in 2021, 2025, and 2026 respectively.
